policies.title: VPN remote access maintenance
policies.topic: VPN disconnects, remote access authentication and tunnel maintenance
instructions: Route investigation to Network Operations. Maintenance is permitted on Monday at 23:00 UTC.
Route investigation to Identity Operations. Maintenance is permitted on Wednesday at 01:00 UTC.
Route investigation to Access Engineering. Maintenance is permitted on Saturday at 03:00 UTC.

policies.title: Mailbox quota expansion
policies.topic: mailbox storage quota expansion and email delivery
instructions: The approved individual mailbox limit is 20 GB. Refer requests above that limit to Messaging.
The approved individual mailbox limit is 40 GB. Refer requests above that limit to Messaging.
The approved individual mailbox limit is 60 GB. Refer requests above that limit to Messaging.

policies.title: Production service restart
policies.topic: production restart maintenance change approval and service outage
instructions: Obtain approval from the service owner before a production restart.
Obtain approval from the change board before a production restart.
Obtain approval from the incident commander before a production restart.

policies.title: Employee access offboarding
policies.topic: employee departure account access offboarding and credential revocation
instructions: Queue credential revocation within 24 hours after confirmed departure.
Queue credential revocation within 4 hours after confirmed departure.
Queue credential revocation within 1 hour after confirmed departure.

policies.title: Laptop replacement and custody
policies.topic: damaged laptop replacement inventory custody and equipment handover
instructions: The local asset custodian approves equipment replacement and records the handover.
The central asset team approves equipment replacement and records the handover.
The regional asset team approves equipment replacement and records the handover.

policies.title: Backup restoration request
policies.topic: backup restoration recovery point storage retention and restore authorization
instructions: A restore request may select a recovery point from the last 7 days.
A restore request may select a recovery point from the last 14 days.
A restore request may select a recovery point from the last 30 days.

policies.title: VPN remote access maintenance
policies.topic: VPN disconnects, remote access authentication and tunnel maintenance
instructions: Only the laboratory network team may approve Monday maintenance.
Only the laboratory network team may approve Tuesday maintenance.
Only the laboratory network team may approve Friday maintenance.

policies.title: Production service restart
policies.topic: production restart maintenance change approval and service outage
instructions: The laboratory service owner approves a restart.
The laboratory lead approves a restart.
The laboratory director approves a restart.
